definition: For every world v and act a, any two outputs x,y of a at v are equal. This is at-most-one uniqueness at each world, not cross-world output invariance, existence of an output, or a physical determinism thesis.
note: Explicit diagnostic for issue #462; no source attribution. Source-grounded act individuation and metaphysical adoption remain open. See docs/notes/selected-effect-bridge-462.md.
